# StampGrade

> A free website scorecard. Paste a URL and get one score out of 100 from
> fifteen deterministic checks, a stamped grade letter (A–F), and a shareable
> grade card.

StampGrade runs fifteen pass/fail checks against a page. The engine is
deterministic: the same page produces the same score on every run. There are no
AI opinions and no weighting that changes over time.

## The fifteen checks

- HTTPS — loads over a secure connection
- SSL_EXPIRY — certificate valid, not about to lapse
- SECURITY_HEADERS — HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options present
- TITLE_TAG — a title exists and fits a search result
- META_DESCRIPTION — a description Google can actually show
- HEADINGS — one clear H1, sane order
- CANONICAL — Google is told which URL is real
- ROBOTS_TXT — crawlers get instructions, not guesses
- SITEMAP — an XML sitemap exists and is referenced
- OG_TAGS — links unfurl with an image, not a gray box
- TWITTER_CARD — shares on X render rich
- FAVICON — a real icon, not the default globe
- VIEWPORT — the page knows how to behave on phones
- ALT_TEXT — images carry alt text
- AI_READINESS — llms.txt and AI-crawler directives in place

## Grading

90+ is an A, 80+ a B, 65+ a C, 50+ a D, below 50 an F.

## Plans

- Free — unlimited scans, score, grade and share card, top three issues
- Pro ($12/mo) — full fix-it report ranked by impact
- Agency ($29/mo) — ten sites, white-label, watermark removed
